lines: In the fading days, a shadow with no place
One is in a panic
It seems to beg for forgiveness, pitiful
The seeds I planted start to bloom
You grow colder
My outstretched palm slices the sky
Will it ever return to how it was?
Being swallowed by the surging waves
Moving forward while breaking the future
Will the end come?
If I am shattered and torn apart
Even if I scatter in disgrace, I fear nothing
Because I'm already completely empty
Alas, at the end, be sure to extinguish this light
I want nothing any more, because I'm afraid of losing again
Since losing you, the world is filled with only dark news
No matter what I do, sorrow knows no bounds
Will we ever meet again? Unrepentant, I lament
No matter how much I brood, unclouded regret spreads across my palm
If I am shattered and torn apart
Even if I scatter in disgrace, I fear nothing
Yet the shaking won't cease
I still want to be here, with you
There are many things I will never lose
So I cannot depart yet, even if no one else desires it
If I am shattered and torn apart
Even if I scatter in disgrace, I fear nothing
Because you are beside me, every day
Alas, until it ends, until that moment, I will keep chasing
I reach toward the light waiting at the farthest edge of these days
Even though morning is said to be near
The fog remains unbroken
Tracing that uncertain outline
While confirming it, I move forward
